Hollis isn't the account owner, CFO or deal desk, so I need your (or Anselm's) approval before I put the rate in a draft to him. OK to go ahead?

Once she or Anselm OKs it, I'll save the draft to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" and the $2,356/seat figure. You can also ping either of them yourself if that's quicker.
